about_the_game:
This DLC is for players who’ve enjoyed Soulbound and want to directly support the small team behind it.

We’re a tiny indie crew that built Soulbound with a lot of care (and a bit of chaos). Buying this pack helps us continue working on updates, new ideas, and future projects, with 100% of the revenue going straight to the developers.

This isn’t a content expansion, it’s a gesture of support. But to say thanks, we’ve included a set of digital extras that give you a peek behind the curtain on what it took to make Soulbound!

❤️ Direct Developer Support

100% of the revenue from this pack goes straight to the team behind Soulbound, no publishers, no middlemen. Your support helps us keep making weird, creative games like this one.

🎙️ Exclusive Developer Interview

A candid conversation with two of the original developers, sharing how Soulbound was made, from chaotic prototypes to launch day. Honest, indie, and full of love for the process.

🗒️ Original Game Pitch Documents

The raw notepad page that started it all. See how Soulbound began, as a scrappy little idea—and how much it has changed since day one.

🎨 Mini Digital Art Book (PDF)

A behind-the-scenes look at the game’s visual design: early sketches, scrapped enemy ideas, pixel iterations, and developer notes.

🖼️ Key Art Bundle

High-resolution illustrations and promotional art, perfect for desktops, posters, or just appreciating the game’s retro-inspired style.

🎵 Mini Soundtrack (3 Tracks)

Two original tracks that power Soulbound’s action. Available in MP3 and WAV, short, punchy, and crafted to match the game’s speed and spirit.

🕹️ Character Sprites & Animated Gifs

A collection of expressive sprite sheets and character animations from the game, great for fan art, sharing, or just enjoying up close.

This pack is entirely optional. It won’t change the gameplay or unlock any in-game content. It’s simply a way to show your support and help fund what we create next.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for helping small teams like ours keep developing!
